'''Lumat''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-furred [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who helped the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] defeat the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="rotj" /> He was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Zephee/Legends|Zephee]] and was the father of [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]], and [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]]. In his [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], he was the chief woodcutter,<ref name="CSWE" /> an archer, a woodcarver, and an [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|elder advisor]] to tribe [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Lumat}}</ref> Lumat was named for the [[Lumat (axe)|legendary axe]] wielded by [[Machook (legend)|Machook]] in Ewok mythology.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Lumat carried a [[Bow/Legends|bow]] and [[Spear/Legends|spear]], and wore a brown hood and sash-mounted quiver in which he stored [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#104: Lumat|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Lumat_Vintage_Collection_TVC_VC104.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lumat was made into an action figure by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] in [[1984]]. Upon his initial release, he was in a [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|''Return of the Jedi'']] packaged with a bow and one&ndash;piece quiver, hood, and sash. The second release, on [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1985 toy line)|''Power of the Force'']] packaging, added a coin to his accessories.<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (toy line)|pack=Lumat|link=VINtLumat.asp}}</ref> In [[2012]] Lumat received his second figure in the ''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]'' line, now including a spear and three arrows, in addition to updated versions<ref name="Hasbro" /> of his original accessories.<ref name="Kenner" />

[[File:Lumat_ccg.png|thumb|left|180px|Graak, once known as Lumat]]
While the action figure shows Lumat to be an Ewok with solid gray fur,<ref name="Kenner" /> his [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|Customizable Card Game]] (CCG) card pictured an Ewok with black and gray striped fur,<ref name="CCG" /> later identified as [[Graak]].<ref name="GraakCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|356|Graak}}</ref> Hasbro's Graak figure, released in [[2007]], depicts both Lumat and Graak on its packaging, and bears Graak's black and gray colors,<ref name="GraakHasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#43: Romba & Graak (Ewok Warriors)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC43ewoks.asp}}</ref> matching that of the "Lumat" CCG card.<ref name="CCG" /> "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Ewoks: Warriors of Endor!]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 135|''Star Wars Insider'' 135]] established that Lumat was indeed the Ewok from the Kenner figure and not the CCG card.

Lumat can be seen in the Special Edition DVD of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] at frame 1:12:32.
